name: Multigrain Low GI Bread
ingredients_raw: Chakki Fresh Atta (Whole Wheat Flour), Protein Blend (Soya Protein Isolate, Pea Protein Isolate), Multigrain Seed Mix (Rolled Oats, Barley Flakes, Flax Seeds, Sunflower Seeds, White Sesame Seeds, Soya Bean Seed Grits, Watermelon Seeds), Wheat Gluten, Fresh Yeast, Wheat Bran, Rice Bran Oil (Edible Vegetable Oil), Fructooligosaccharide, Cultured Wheat Flour, Iodised Salt.
